intro.text: The young son of King Elhokar and Queen Aesudan of Alethkar, living in the palace at Kholinar.
The young son of King Elhokar and Queen Aesudan, brought out of Kholinar by Drehy and Skar after the city's fall.
The young son of King Elhokar, now living in Urithiru with Adolin, Dalinar and Navani, and determined to learn to fight.
The son of King Elhokar and heir to Queen Jasnah, who faced Dalinar as Odium's champion in the Contest of Champions.

items.text: When Kaladin and Elhokar stormed the palace and found Aesudan, Kaladin went looking for Gavinor. Rather than playing with friends, as his mother had claimed, the boy was being tormented by spren, and Kaladin killed one with Syl as a dagger. Gavinor screamed and fled from Kaladin, but Elhokar comforted him and whispered something that stopped his crying, then picked him up.
In the fighting at the palace, Elhokar, holding Gavinor, was one word from speaking the Immortal Words when Moash ran him through with a spear, shoving Gavinor aside before the final blow.

After the Battle of Thaylen Field, Kaladin flew back to Alethkar to find Drehy and Skar. He found them by a dried-up river, sheltering under a tarp painted with the Bridge Four symbol, with a few servants they had saved, and Gavinor.
Ialai Sadeas posed as a patriot who would rescue Gavinor from the Blackthorn and his aunt by ruling as queen until he came of age, but Shallan killed her before she could rebel.

His father's death left a deep mark on Gavinor; Navani noticed he treated even play as serious. He asked her whether Dalinar could teach him to fight so he could kill Moash one day, and Dalinar showed him how to hold practice swords. Szeth feared that Gavinor, who had begun to laugh again, would someday have that taken from him.
Lift spent a long time with Gavinor in Urithiru, trying to draw him out of his shell, and taught him a secret handshake so he would feel he belonged.

Lift taught Gavinor that sometimes disobeying his elders was right, so he followed her when she spied on Dalinar sending his mind into the Spiritual Realm. When Mraize struck the perpendicularity with a dagger carrying Anti-Light, it collapsed, pulling Gavinor, Dalinar and Navani bodily into the Spiritual Realm.

Dalinar soon found Navani and Gavinor through his Connection to them. Gavinor still feared spren after his torment in Kholinar, so Dalinar told him the visions they entered were only make-believe. The people of one vision took him for a spren at first, so suddenly did he appear.
Throughout, Gavinor heard what seemed to be his father's voice, likely Odium playing on his admiration for Elhokar. He became convinced that, like Dalinar, he would be a king trained by a god.

Gavinor was shown visions of Dalinar's worst failures and was outraged to see Dalinar assault Elhokar, not knowing why he had done it. When Navani left the Spiritual Realm thinking she carried Gavinor, she had only a perfect copy of him made of meat, left by Taravangian.

Odium took Gavinor into a vision that lasted twenty years in the space of an hour in the Physical Realm. There Taravangian taught him to hate Dalinar, convincing him that Dalinar had taken Elhokar's kingdom and sent him off to die, and promised him Alethkar under Odium if he won. He became an expert with the Shardblade, defeating several visions of Dalinar.

Gavinor emerged from the Spiritual Realm carrying Dalinar's old Shardblade, Oathbringer, and confronted Dalinar, who saw how strongly he resembled his father. Taravangian betrayed him, paralysing him in the fight. Dalinar refused to kill him, and protected him with his last breath from the storm that followed the contest.

appearance.text: When Kaladin found him in the Kholinar palace, Gavinor was a small boy of about four, wearing a Kholin blue uniform and holding a stuffed soldier dressed the same way.
When he was rescued from Kholinar, he was dressed in rags, with chapped lips and haunted eyes.
After some time in Urithiru, he is a healthy but small and reserved boy, with dark hair and pure yellow eyes, who carries a little wooden sword everywhere.

personality.text: Elhokar knew how to calm his son when he cried, and Gavinor loved him dearly, swearing bloody revenge on Moash after his father's death.

Under his mother's changed rule in Kholinar, Gavinor grew frightened of her and of most people. He was left timid and easily scared, and it took over a year for him to become lively and sociable again.

In Urithiru, Adolin teaches him to ride, Dalinar trains him with the sword, and Navani spends time with him when she can; they enjoy each other's company. He does not seem to fear Szeth, smiling and waving his wooden sword at him.
Lift believes he needs a friend rather than someone telling him to grow up, and cheers him whenever he doubts the intentions of those around him. They share a special two-fingered handshake.
